tuition.quote: El ingreso a la UBA es irrestricto y sin examen de ingreso. Los estudios de grado en la UBA son gratuitos para los ciudadanos argentinos y extranjeros.
tuition.notes: UBA Noticias, 'INGRESO A LA UBA 2026 ... ABRE LA INSCRIPCIÓN PARA INGRESAR A LA UNIVERSIDAD DE BUENOS AIRES EN 2026' (martes 11 de noviembre de 2025): 'preinscripción al CBC para el ciclo lectivo 2026'. Undergraduate study is free (gratuito) for Argentine and foreign citizens; recorded as amount 0. academic_year '2026' is the page's 'ciclo lectivo 2026' (Argentina's academic year is the calendar year, starting March), so for a 2027 entry this is the previous cycle's statement and is expected to be kept as a stale fact. No 2027 statement is published yet (no 2027 ingreso news on uba.ar as of 2026-10-19). Free tuition does not cover the cost of living, the legalisation of a foreign secondary diploma (convalidación) or other fees.
